description: This Java class implements a builder pattern for creating responses and events related to deleting an attribute in an Eclipse Ditto live command context. It provides methods to generate success responses and error responses for specific failure scenarios, as well as event objects to indicate attribute deletion.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class that extends an abstract builder to create command responses and event objects specific to delete attribute live commands in a thread-unsafe, mutable manner.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: An internal immutable class implementing ResponseFactory, creating success and error responses for attribute deletion outcomes.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: An internal immutable class implementing EventFactory, creating an event representing attribute deletion, timestamped with the current instant.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new builder for a given delete attribute command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a command response by applying the provided response factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an event object by applying the provided event factory function.
